svg.text: 8 — A seller issues start before the resource is delivered
honest storefront: start refused by the kit without commit ack + dispatch begun
start (payee) at t0 — a dishonest storefront's own client
periods count from t0; start event sequence s
buyer records: credentials at t1, resource answers at t2
snapshot → verify proof; read start event (t0, s)
buyer keeps: (t0, s) vs (t1, t2); gap = pre-delivery charge
dispute: the buyer presents the gap to the dispute authority; reverse is authorized for [payee, dispute]
reverse by the dispute authority: periods in [t0, t2)
status: signed lease_ended at the deal's end (buyer keeps)
The buyer's recorded delivery instants against the signed start event are its dispute evidence; the kit refuses a start without evidence
